data.narrative:
DroneForge is a pre-seed autonomous systems company led by founder Chester Zelaya that has raised $2.5M to date. The target operates within the Drones & Autonomous sector, which contains eight private peer companies including Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro. No public comparables exist in this narrow sector-stage intersection.

Given the pre-seed stage and limited peer cohort at identical stage and valuation tier, only one valuation method proved applicable. The stage-progression approach uses the $2.5M total raised as a base proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of pre-seed-to-seed advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $6M. A peer-median approach could not be applied: while seven same-sector peers exist, none satisfied the filters for same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with sufficient data density (threshold: ≥3 datapoints). Relying on all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable cross-stage and cross-scale bias.

The triangulated range supported by available data is $5M to $7M, centered on $6M. This valuation reflects typical stage-level markups but carries material uncertainty given the absence of tight peer benchmarks. Key unknowns include product maturity, IP defensibility within autonomous systems, and market traction metrics not captured in this dataset. Investors should treat this as a preliminary floor pending deeper operational diligence.
